title: Error Handling
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:48 AM
The response contains the payment terms (name and code) for the specified contract account.

Error Handling

Typical errors that may occur with this operation are:

e Nocontract account ID is specified in the query

e Thecontract account ID specified in the query is invalid

Message Types

e ContractAccountPaymentTermsBylDQuery

e¢ ContractAccountPaymentTermsBylDResponse

Prerequisites

The user has to have the required authorization to read the specified contract account.

Notes on SAP Implementation
Prerequisites
You are using software component FI-CA (as of version FI-CA 6.02).

You have maintained the backend configuration of SAP Biller Direct in FI-CA (see Customizing for Contract Accounts Receivable
and Payable under Integration -> Financial Supply Chain Management -> Biller Direct -> Basic Setting for Customer Portal in

Internet ). Note that since this operation is based on the functions of SAP Biller Direct , its use is subject to the same license
conditions.

The user has sufficient authorizations, in particular with regard to authorization object F_LKK_EBPP.

Processing

If an external contract account ID is specified in the query, it has to be mapped to the corresponding internal contract account ID.
This mapping is carried out based on the definition of event 6600.
